known_limitations: Original 146 project records retained, not exhaustive current manga canon
Only 23 historically illustrated models; all stylised, not canon-exact
RawGitHack and real Android performance not independently checked
diagnostic_defects_fixed: Fire-sail surfaces were edge-on from the front: changed blade basis and increased thickness, rerendered
Paramecia high bloom looked detached: extended structural stem into bloom core and created rear sepal
Zoan foliage excessively compressed: broadened radial crown lobes and thickened crown heights
Increasing sculptural width clipped mobile sides: moved 3D camera back and lifted camera centre
Unnecessary STYLISED APPEARANCE line on every illustrated fruit: removed, retained APPEARANCE UNKNOWN on sealed fruits
QA family button click intercepted by focused canvas area: test now directly clicks visible focus button, with first canvas tap still tested separately
still_open: The Zoan canopy remains deliberately low-poly and some lobes still appear procedural
Logia clouds and fires need further sculptural design refinement, not fully concept-art fidelity
Paramecia flowers are stylised and not based on final handcrafted meshes
Waterfalls from opposing high angles can still feel separated from the rock even though stream source intersects its rim
Canon-specific physical fruit appearances remain unaudited; actual Android GPU performance unbenchmarked
